quotes.summary_phrase: NBA teams are increasingly subsidizing summer team trips

quotes.quote: The teams are getting new jets. Do you know about this, Slater? The teams have for the last seven to ten years been using this fleet of Delta 757s. They're outfitted for NBA teams. quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard allegedly had a secret sponsorship with Daktronics
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard had a hidden, multimillion-dollar sponsorship with Clippers' scoreboard-makers.
quotes.quote: Pablo Torre late last week had an update to his reporting on Kawhi Leonard and the Clippers. And let me just say, it involved the scoreboard maker Daktronics, who did the $100 million scoreboard at Intuit Dome, the halo board they called. It's an unusual scoreboard like no one ever seen. Instead of most scoreboards, you're looking at the four or five or six sides, but you're looking at the outside, it's hanging in the center and you're looking at the outside. The halo board goes all around the whole arena and you're looking up sort of in the inside of the ring. And I mean the outside too, but the inside of the ring. So it has a completely different vantage point and way more surface area. I don't know for a fact, but it's probably the most elaborate scoreboard ever built in an arena.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Windhorst discusses the suspicious nature of the Aspiration deal
quotes.excerpt: The guy who ran Aspiration was a fraudster.
quotes.quote: When the Aspiration story came out a year ago, for me, Slater, it was hard to understand because I didn't understand what Aspiration was as a company. I didn't understand carbon credits. I didn't understand how this was such a big business, planting trees and selling carbon credits. And it definitely was highly suspicious, which led the NBA to an investigation. But I had difficulty understanding it, and also the guy who ran Aspiration was a fraudster. To me, it looked like a Ponzi scheme where he needed new investment to keep his Ponzi scheme going, and he did whatever made Steve Ballmer happy because he was where he was getting the new investment from. That to me looked like what it was.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks signs a three-year extension with the Suns
quotes.excerpt: Dillon Brooks agreeing to a three-year, $73 million contract extension with the Phoenix Suns.
quotes.quote: We did have some NBA business since we last got together, contractual business, and that was Dillon Brooks agreeing to a three-year, $73 million contract extension with the Phoenix Suns. Dillon had a terrific year in his first year in Phoenix. He achieved more than a lot of people thought that they would. He had one year and $21 million left on his deal, and so he adds three years starting at $22.5 million in 27-28. So the new money doesn't begin for a year.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers' denials regarding the Aspiration deal were very strong
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers' full-throated denials both publicly and privately have been so strong.
quotes.quote: There's certain people who want the book thrown at the Clippers. They want the Clippers to be held accountable on all this. Let me just say, the Clippers' full-throated denials both publicly and privately have been so strong. And I'm not, I mean, I'm talking about on a personal level, with the highest levels of the Clippers to my face. If I was on a jury, their denials were so strong. And not just like saying we didn't do it, and then saying it with a pleading look in their face, but they're, you know, the case that they laid out in all this stuff, it was an evidentiary case.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's situation has significant fallout for the Raptors
quotes.excerpt: Whether Kawhi Leonard is on the Raptors or not has a huge circumstantial fallout.
quotes.quote: Whether Kawhi Leonard is on the Raptors or not has a huge circumstantial fallout in the Eastern Conference. And then obviously, DeMar DeRozan is held up to a certain extent, for example, and some other players. But James Harden hasn't done his business with the Cavs because they're waiting on things. Peyton Watson, Benedict Mathurin is an important Clippers, there's a series of things here. But even beyond the free agent logjam, the Raptors have been building their team around Kawhi. They've been ready to extend his contract. Brandon Ingram has been ready to be a Clipper. Do you think Brandon Ingram is in the head space to go back and be a Raptor at this point?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Multiple teams contacted the league office about the Kawhi trade
quotes.excerpt: Multiple teams talked to the league office. The league office said they wouldn't stop a trade.
quotes.quote: Multiple teams talked to the league office. The league office said they wouldn't stop a trade in June, and then they went ahead with the deal. And you know, the reason the league is is being very careful here is this there's still not over the fallout from the Terry Rozier situation. Now, to to remind you of that, Terry Rozier was investigated by the league. The investigation was never public. They did not find wrongdoing, and then the Hornets traded him to Miami and the Heat were in the dark.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Suns' salary structure for their core players
quotes.excerpt: You got Devin Booker at $61 million, Jalen Green as a player option at $36 million.
quotes.quote: You got Devin Booker at $61 million, Jalen Green as a player option at $36 million. Maybe he does a new deal and replaces that number, but for now I'm going to put $36 million. So that's that's, you know, that's $97 million for those two players. I can't wait for one of the names you're going to be mentioning coming up that is on the books and also a free agent right now. You got Dillon Brooks at $22.5, so that's, you know, $120 million for those three players. And whatever Bridges signs for, and I doubt it'll be for a pay cut, you know, so between those four players you're looking at, you know, probably going to be in the neighborhood of, you know, $150 million for those four players. And then of course the Bradley Beal, $19.3 million for years into the future.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst

quotes.excerpt: When you have five players on your books making that much money, you're very likely.
quotes.quote: When you have five players on your books making that much money, you're very likely going to have to be a luxury tax payer and the owner's personal finances are struggling. And that is something to be aware of, and I'm sure if you're a Suns fan you are aware of that, that he had this business, his business is struggling. And so, when you have five players on your books making that much money, you're very likely going to have to be a luxury tax payer and the owner's personal finances are struggling.
